h1: Shopify Product Photos for Pages, Grids and Clips
lead: Make Shopify product photos for the product page and the collection. Try a new background, or make many from pictures you already have. Then add each file yourself in Shopify.

faq.q: What is a Shopify product photo made here?
faq.a: A square photo for the product page, a matching small photo for the collection, or a short video. You start from a photo you upload or a scene you describe.

faq.q: How does a Shopify product photo get made?
faq.a: You upload a picture or describe the scene, pick a style, and download the file. You add it in Shopify yourself. We do not put it on the store for you.

faq.q: Is there a free plan for these Shopify photos?
faq.a: No. There is no free plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Credits are what your monthly plan gives you to spend. Pro is $35 a month for 300 credits, and Premium is $63 a month for 600. A photo costs 24 credits. Downloads have no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file.

faq.q: Can I put these photos on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are yours to put on the product page. You still write the name, the price, and what you say about the product. We do not put the files into Shopify for you.

faq.q: What image size works on a product page?
faq.a: Use a square file, the same width and height, so the product page and the collection match. Check the photo size your store uses before you upload.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection at once?
faq.a: Yes. Make many photos from the pictures you already have. Use the same shape and a similar background, so older products can sit next to new ones.

faq.q: Can I add a video on the product page?
faq.a: Yes. Make a video of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds and add it on the product page yourself. A video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits, based on how long it is. If a file fails, those credits come back on their own.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Start with a clear, well-lit photo of the whole item. [how to take product photos for AI](/guides/product-photo-tips) shows what kind of photo works.

steps_h2: Steps to Make a Shopify Photo or Video
steps_lead: Describe a scene or upload a photo, pick a style, then download.

more_sections.lead: A product page usually needs more than one file. Make each one as its own download.

items.d: A clean photo of the whole item for the collection. Keep the same shape as the photos beside it.
The same product in a room, by the sea, or on a plain background, saved as its own file.
A video of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds that you add on the product page. You can also start that video from the photo you just made.

reasons.lead: Here is what you can do with the photos you already have.

items.d: A photo costs 24 credits. Credits are what your monthly plan gives you to spend. A video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost before you start. If a file fails, those credits come back.
Older products can use the picture they already have. You do not book another film day to refresh the collection.
Make photos for many products at one time. Each item still starts from its own photo.
You do not hire a model, or rent extra items, just to try a new background. The scene starts from the photo you upload.

items.t: Start When the Photo Is Ready
items.d: There is no studio appointment. Make the file in the evening, on a weekend, or between orders.
Make a second photo with a wider or tighter view, a new look, or a new layout. Compare it with the first. You pick which file goes on the product page.
